concepts.name: 01-library-books
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: a single desktop executable app icon concept for BookManager, a Windows/macOS application for organizing and reading comics, ebooks, documents and audiobooks. Produce one standalone square icon image, not a contact sheet or presentation. The existing identity uses navy-blue storage and colorful books; evolve this visual language into a calm polished desktop app icon. Materials: refined matte surfaces, clean geometric shapes, extremely restrained dimensional shading, crisp silhouettes, no texture noise. Front-facing, optically centered, generous 8 percent safe margin around the complete icon. Strong large shapes intended to remain readable at 32px and 48px. Real transparent background outside the icon, no fake checkerboard, no environment, no ground plane, no text labels, no watermark, no platform or file-format logos. Primary request: a compact sculptural library holder with exactly three thick upright books emerging above its front wall. The broad low holder is deep navy blue with softly rounded corners, forming one unified compact silhouette. Three books vary modestly in height and use the blue, teal-green and warm golden yellow hues of the existing multicolor book identity. Books occupy the top two-thirds; front wall occupies the lower third. Emboss one large simple ivory open-book symbol on the navy front, with only two page shapes and no lines or letters. Keep the books chunky and the holder shallow and rectangular, not a cylindrical basket. This should feel like a modern, beautifully finished macOS/Windows application icon with exceptionally clear silhouettes. Do not add a square tile behind the holder.

concepts.name: 02-open-book
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: a single desktop executable app icon concept for BookManager, a Windows/macOS application for organizing and reading comics, ebooks, documents and audiobooks. Produce one standalone square icon image, not a contact sheet or presentation. The existing identity uses navy-blue storage and colorful books; evolve this visual language into a calm polished desktop app icon. Materials: refined matte surfaces, clean geometric shapes, extremely restrained dimensional shading, crisp silhouettes, no texture noise. Front-facing, optically centered, generous 8 percent safe margin around the complete icon. Strong large shapes intended to remain readable at 32px and 48px. Real transparent background outside the icon, no fake checkerboard, no environment, no ground plane, no text labels, no watermark, no platform or file-format logos. Primary request: a bold ivory open book with only two broad sculpted pages, a clear center fold and a small teal ribbon bookmark, centered on a deep navy-blue rounded-square tile. The tile has a subtle blue edge light and very slight thickness, almost front-on. The open-book silhouette occupies about 65 percent of the tile width; pages have gently rounded corners, a slight upward curve and just one visible page layer beneath. The teal bookmark hangs from the upper right page but remains completely inside the tile. Design with strong white/navy contrast and simple geometry. Quiet, balanced, sophisticated. No page writing, no outlines, no extra symbols, no dramatic perspective.
